episodes.title: Dough Bros vs MR. POT 😱 | Animation EP 1
episodes.summary: Bup, Pim and Zeek wake Mr. Pot at midnight and flee to the pantry, where they meet Lolly and the mysterious burnt Crispy. Crispy reveals Mr. Pot's weak spot is extreme cold.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mr. Pot says his 'friends' are waking up, and Frostbite the freezer ghost opens its eyes inside the freezer the heroes plan to visit.

episodes.title: Dough Bros vs FROSTBITE 🥶 | Animation EP 2
episodes.summary: The heroes sneak into the freezer for ice to beat Mr. Pot, but lonely ghost Frostbite tries to keep them forever until Crispy's warmth drives him away. On the dinner table Frostbite returns to warn them that Mr. Pot promised him the Dough Bros as 'friends' and is gathering the mixer and the toaster.
episodes.cliffhanger: The stolen ice is melting (only until sunrise), and in the oven corner Toastmaw the toaster wakes up shouting 'You're TOAST!'

episodes.title: Dough Bros vs TOASTMAW 🍞 | Animation EP 3
episodes.summary: Zeek's Crumb-Catcher 3000 traps Bup, Zeek and Pim instead of the crumb-hating toaster Toastmaw. Lolly's fury and Crispy's trick (shaking out a thousand crumbs) send Toastmaw off to clean.
episodes.cliffhanger: Crispy reveals Toastmaw was hunting for Mr. Pot, and Whisker the mixer spins into the kitchen: 'Let's MIX it up!'

episodes.title: Dough Bros vs WHISKER 🌀 | Animation EP 4
episodes.summary: Pim beats Whisker in a spinning contest until the mixer is too dizzy to fight. Bup and Zeek follow Crispy into the oven and hear Mr. Pot list his growing army of appliances.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mr. Pot wants Crispy, the one he burned long ago, and lunges: 'Then ALL of you will be my dinner!'

episodes.title: Dough Bros vs MR. POT 🔥 | Animation EP 5
episodes.summary: Crispy blinds Mr. Pot with smoke and, in the attic, reveals he was once a golden roll who was burnt saving a baby loaf from Mr. Pot - and that baby was Bup. The team lures Mr. Pot into the fridge where the cold puts him to sleep, but the cold also puts out Crispy's fire.
episodes.cliffhanger: Crispy faints as his ember goes out, and the only warm thing in the kitchen is Old Hissy the kettle, who wakes up screaming 'I'm BOILING!'
